title: ChemGraph-XANES: An Agentic Framework for XANES Simulation and Curation
abstract: arXiv:2604.16205v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Computational X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) is widely used to interpret local coordination environments, oxidation states, and electronic structure, but large computational campaigns are often limited by workflow complexity. We present ChemGraph-XANES, a large language model (LLM)-based agentic framework that combines documentation-grounded parameter retrieval via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), schema-constrained tool execution, deterministic FDMNES input generation, Parsl-backed execution, and provenance-aware data curation. Scripted and natural-language interfaces share a common scientific backend for structure handling, parameterization, execution, spectral extraction, and optional post-processing. We evaluate three workflow modes: documentation-grounded parameter propagation, structure-file-based execution, and composition-based execution from a chemistry-level request. translated_title: ChemGraph-XANES：一种用于XANES模拟与数据管理的智能体框架
translated_abstract: 计算X射线吸收近边结构（XANES）广泛用于解释局部配位环境、氧化态和电子结构，但大规模计算活动常受限于工作流复杂性。我们提出了ChemGraph-XANES，一种基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体框架，它结合了通过检索增强生成（RAG）进行的文档驱动的参数检索、模式约束的工具执行、确定性的FDMNES输入生成、基于Parsl的执行以及来源感知的数据管理。脚本化和自然语言界面共享一个用于结构处理、参数化、执行、光谱提取和可选后处理的通用科学后端。我们评估了三种工作流模式：文档驱动的参数传播、基于结构文件的执行以及基于化学级请求的组成式执行。重复试验获得了端到端的成功。
tldr: 该论文提出了ChemGraph-XANES，一种基于LLM的智能体框架，通过RAG、模式约束和Parsl支持，实现了XANES模拟的自动化与数据管理，显著简化了复杂工作流。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces ChemGraph-XANES, an LLM-based agentic framework that automates XANES simulation and curation via RAG, schema-constrained tools, and Parsl, simplifying complex workflows.
